component.name: HawaOS Companion
component.summary: Stream stats, music, weather and notifications to your desk display

description.p: The desktop companion for HawaOS, a small dashboard OS for the LilyGo T-Display-S3. It lives in your tray and keeps the device up to date with your PC's CPU, memory and network, the music you're playing with its album art, the weather, and your desktop notifications.

ul.li: Add a device over USB or Bluetooth with a guided setup
Connect over Wi-Fi or Bluetooth, with encrypted traffic either way
Change theme, accent color, brightness and the always-on display live
Install firmware updates over the air

description.p: Synced lyrics on the device's Media screen and always-on display, from LRCLIB (you can turn them off). The device follows your computer's lock: its screen turns off, shows the always-on display or stays as it is. A microphone icon shows while an app records you, and the device can mute and unmute it. The companion is also available as .deb and .rpm packages and as an AppImage.

The companion now runs on Windows 10 and 11 too, with a one-line installer. Opening the companion while it's already running brings up its window instead of starting a second copy. The companion tells you when a newer HawaOS release is out (you can turn this off).

Titles and notifications in any script: Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hebrew, Bengali and other Indic scripts, and emoji, shaped on your computer and shown on the device. Accented letters show again. Notifications keep their bold text, line breaks and links. A firmware update that doesn't start properly is rolled back automatically, and setting a board up again keeps all your settings. A new logo that takes your accent colour.

Your own picture as the device's wallpaper, sent over Wi-Fi, Bluetooth or USB and kept through restarts. The screen can turn fully off after a while on the always-on display. Album art that can't be loaded is now explained in the log.
Album art works again in the Flatpak: the companion can now read the cover files media players save.
First release: a guided setup over USB or Bluetooth, encrypted Wi-Fi and Bluetooth links, over-the-air firmware updates, and album art over every link.
